messages.text:
"Create a playable 3D chibi volleyball
mobile game called VOLLEY CHAMPIONS 3D.

VISUAL STYLE:
- Cute 3D chibi anime characters.
- Big heads and small bodies.
- Colorful volleyball uniforms.
- Beautiful indoor volleyball stadium.
- Smooth and fun animations.
- High quality 3D graphics.

GAMEPLAY:
- Third person camera behind the player.
- Control only one player.
- Virtual joystick on the left.
- Action buttons on the right.
- Jump, pass, set, spike, block and serve.
- Teammates and opponents controlled by AI.
- Functional volleyball physics and net.

GAME MODES:
- 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, 5v5 and 6v6.
- Match score up to 25 points.

CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION:
- Male and female characters.
- Different hairstyles and hair colors.
- Custom uniforms and jersey numbers.
- Custom team names and colors.

Make the game playable on Android phones
in landscape mode.
Start with a working 3D volleyball
prototype, not just a static scene.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
